headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 15, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers 9-5.

Injuries and availability continue to impact teams across the league. Abner Uribe of the Milwaukee Brewers has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. Additionally, Colt Emerson of the Seattle Mariners has been placed on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Boston Red Sox made the trade.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, securing a narrow victory. Chase Burns led the way for the Reds, pitching 7.0 innings with 8 strikeouts and no earned runs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **Brewers' Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The trade was made by the Boston Red Sox.
